literal: Profit that which is called to a person fools' friendship having abandoned letting go.
translation: The true profit for a person is to abandon and let go of the friendship of fools.
modern: ஒருவருக்கு உண்மையான லாபம் என்று சொல்லப்படுவது, அறிவற்றவர்களின் நட்பை விட்டு விலகிவிடுவதே ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines what constitutes a true gain or profit (ஊதியம்) in the context of choosing friends. It states that for any person, the greatest benefit is simply walking away from the friendship of fools (பேதையார் கேண்மை). The word 'ஒரீஇ' (having abandoned) combined with 'விடல்' (letting go) emphasizes a complete and decisive separation. By placing this in the chapter on investigating friendship, the text highlights that avoiding bad company is just as valuable as acquiring good friends.
